shortfall: Two journals have no entries. (1) The Philosophical Review: I could not retrieve the research-article list for 134(1), January 2025. The issue page I reached showed only book reviews and front and back matter. Book reviews sit at pp. 69–81, so any articles would be on earlier pages, but I could not verify any. I did not guess. Issue 134(2) has Sam Berstler's 'The Structure of Open Secrets' and Blumberg & Holguín's 'Fictional Reality' (doi 10.1215/00318108-11676103). I did not list them, because rule 5 only lets me use issue 2 once issue 1 is exhausted, and I could not confirm that. (2) The Journal of Philosophy: the first 2025 issue is the double issue 122(1/2), Jan/Feb 2025, which is the Dewey Lectures 2023 special issue. All of it is excluded under rule 3. Rule 5 sends me to the next issue, 122(3), but I could not retrieve its table of contents before my search budget ran out. For Mind, Lampert's entry is verified=false because I confirmed its author, title and DOI only from the issue table of contents, not from its own article page.
